# Google Play (9 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /app-search | `query` | 5 | Search Google Play apps by keyword |
| /search-suggestions | `query` | 1 | Get Google Play search suggestions |
| /app-info | `app_id` | 5 | Get full Google Play app details |
| /app-reviews | `app_id` | 5 | Get Google Play reviews for an app |
| /app-list | `app_collection` | 5 | Get a Google Play store chart |
| /app-listings-search | `title` | 10 | Search the Google Play listings database (paginated) |
| /categories | *(none)* | 1 | List Google Play app categories |
| /locations | *(none)* | 1 | List supported Google Play storefront locations |
| /languages | *(none)* | 1 | List supported Google Play languages |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- *(none)* — no required parameters.

## Parameter Details

- `query`: Search keyword (e.g. 'photo editor').
- `country` *(optional, string)*: Storefront country as a DFS location name ('United States') or numeric location code ('2840'). Defaults to the US.
- `language` *(optional, string)*: Language code (e.g. 'en'). Defaults to 'en'.
- `depth` *(optional, integer)*: Number of results to retrieve (default 30, rounded up to multiples of 30, max 300).
- `query (/search-suggestions)`: Partial search keyword to autocomplete (e.g. 'reverse').
- `country (/search-suggestions)` *(optional, string)*: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 storefront country code. Defaults to 'us'.
- `language (/search-suggestions)` *(optional, string)*: ISO 639-1 language code. Defaults to 'en'.
- `app_id`: Google Play package name (e.g. 'com.spotify.music'), from app-search.
- `country (/app-info)` *(optional, string)*: Storefront country as a DFS location name or numeric code. Defaults to the US.
- `country (/app-reviews)` *(optional, string)*: Storefront country as a DFS location name or numeric code. Defaults to the US.
- `depth (/app-reviews)` *(optional, integer)*: Number of reviews to retrieve (default 150, batches of 150, max 600).
- `sort_by` *(optional, enum: newest | most_relevant)*: Review ordering: `newest` (default) or `most_relevant`.
- `rating` *(optional, integer)*: Filter to a single star rating (1–5).
- `app_collection`: Chart to retrieve: topselling_free, topselling_paid, topgrossing, movers_shakers, topselling_new_free, topselling_new_paid.
- `app_category` *(optional, enum: art_and_design | auto_and_vehicles | beauty | books_and_reference | business | comics | communication | dating | education | entertainment | events | finance | food_and_drink | health_and_fitness | house_and_home | libraries_and_demo | lifestyle | maps_and_navigation | medical | music_and_audio | news_and_magazines | parenting | personalization | photography | productivity | shopping | social | sports | tools | travel_and_local | video_players | android_wear | watch_face | weather | game | game_action | game_adventure | game_arcade | game_board | game_card | game_casino | game_casual | game_educational | game_music | game_puzzle | game_racing | game_role_playing | game_simulation | game_sports | game_strategy | game_trivia | game_word | family)*: Optional Google Play category to scope the chart (e.g. 'photography', 'game_puzzle').
- `country (/app-list)` *(optional, string)*: Storefront country as a DFS location name or numeric code. Defaults to the US.
- `depth (/app-list)` *(optional, integer)*: Number of apps to retrieve (default 100, max 500).
- `title`: App title to search for (e.g. 'photo editor').
- `description` *(optional, string)*: Optional app-description text to match.
- `limit` *(optional, integer)*: Apps per page (1–50, default 20).
- `offset` *(optional, integer)*: Pagination offset (up to 10,000; use offset_token beyond).
- `offset_token` *(optional, string)*: Opaque deep-pagination cursor from a prior response.
- `filters` *(optional, string)*: Advanced DataForSEO filter expression as a JSON array.
- `country (/app-listings-search)` *(optional, string)*: Storefront country as a DFS location name or numeric code. Defaults to the US.

## Example

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google_play/app-search?query=photo editor" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
